text_en: Ah, you who make iniquitous decrees, who write oppressive statutes,
text_cn: 祸哉，那些制定不义的法例，记录不义的断案，

text_en: to turn aside the needy from justice and to rob the poor of my people of their right, that widows may be your spoil, and that you may make the orphans your prey!
text_cn: 为屈枉小民的案件，剥削我穷民的权利，攘夺寡妇和劫掠孤儿的人！

text_en: What will you do on the day of punishment, in the calamity that will come from far away? To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your wealth,
text_cn: 当惩罚之日，风暴由远而近的时候，你们将怎样应付？你们将向谁求助？你们的财宝将弃于何地？

text_en: so as not to crouch among the prisoners or fall among the slain? For all this his anger has not turned away; his hand is stretched out still.
text_cn: 唯有屈服在被俘者中，倒毙在被杀者下；然而他的震怒并未因此而熄灭，他的手仍然伸着。

text_en: Ah, Assyria, the rod of my anger— the club in their hands is my fury!
text_cn: 祸哉，亚述！我义怒的木棒，我震怒的棍杖！

text_en: Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to take spoil and seize plunder, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
text_cn: 我派遣她是为攻击一个邪恶的百姓，我委任他是为攻击我所愤恨的民族，为掳掠劫夺，并为蹂躏他们，有如街上的粪土。

text_en: But this is not what he intends, nor does he have this in mind; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off nations not a few.
text_cn: 但她并没有这样想，心里也没有这样推测，只图肆意破坏，剿灭不少的民族。

text_en: For he says: “Are not my commanders all kings?
text_cn: 因为她说：“我的首领不都是君王吗？

text_en: Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
text_cn: 加耳诺不是与加革米士一样吗？哈玛特不是与阿尔帕得一样吗？撒玛黎雅不是与大马士革一样吗？

text_en: As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols whose images were greater than those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
text_cn: 我的手既然征服了这些偶像的王国──况且他们的偶像还多过耶路撒冷和撒玛黎雅──

text_en: shall I not do to Jerusalem and her idols what I have done to Samaria and her images? ”
text_cn: 难道我不能对待耶路撒冷和她的神像，有如对待了撒玛黎雅和她的偶像吗？”

text_en: When the Lord has finished all his work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, he will punish the arrogant boasting of the king of Assyria and his haughty pride.
text_cn: 当吾主对熙雍山和耶路撒冷完成了他的一切工作时，必要惩罚亚述王心高气傲的功绩，和他目空一切的骄傲。

text_en: For he says: “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding; I have removed the boundaries of peoples, and have plundered their treasures; like a bull I have brought down those who sat on thrones.
text_cn: 因为他曾说过：“我完成了这一切，全凭我的手和我的智慧，因为我是聪明的；我撤除了各族的界限，掳掠了他们的财宝，有如强者打倒了居于高位的人。

text_en: My hand has found, like a nest, the wealth of the peoples; and as one gathers eggs that have been forsaken, so I have gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved a wing, or opened its mouth, or chirped. ”
text_cn: 我的手夺取了列国的财富，有如取诸窝巢；我兼并了大地，有如拾取遗卵，没有谁敢鼓翼或张口鼓噪。”

text_en: Shall the ax vaunt itself over the one who wields it, or the saw magnify itself against the one who handles it? As if a rod should raise the one who lifts it up, or as if a staff should lift the one who is not wood!
text_cn: 斧头岂能对用斧头砍伐的人自豪？锯岂能向拉锯的人自夸？难道棍杖能挥动那举它的人？木棒能举起那不是木头的人？

text_en: Therefore the Sovereign, the Lord of hosts, will send wasting sickness among his stout warriors, and under his glory a burning will be kindled, like the burning of fire.
text_cn: 因此吾主，万军的天主，将瘦弱放在她的肥硕之中，在她的光辉之下燃起火焰，有如烈火焚烧。

text_en: The light of Israel will become a fire, and his Holy One a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and briers in one day.
text_cn: 以色列的光将变为火，他的圣者将变为烈焰，一日间即将她的荆棘蒺(jí)藜(lí)焚毁。

text_en: The glory of his forest and his fruitful land the Lord will destroy, both soul and body, and it will be as when an invalid wastes away.
text_cn: 她的丛林和她田园的华丽，必将由内到外毁灭，有如为虫蚀尽一样。

text_en: The remnant of the trees of his forest will be so few that a child can write them down.
text_cn: 她的丛林所剩余的树木不多，一个儿童就能计算。

text_en: On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no more lean on the one who struck them, but will lean on the Lord , the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
text_cn: 到那一日，以色列的遗民和雅各伯家的逃亡者，不再依恃打击他们的人，却诚心依赖上主，以色列的圣者。

text_en: A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
text_cn: 遗民必将归回，雅各伯的遗民必将归依强有力的天主！

text_en: For though your people Israel were like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. Destruction is decreed, overflowing with righteousness.
text_cn: 以色列啊！你的百姓虽然多如海沙，其中唯有残存者得以归回：毁灭已经决定，但是充溢着公义，

text_en: For the Lord God of hosts will make a full end, as decreed, in all the earth.
text_cn: 因为吾主，万军的上主必在大地上执行所决定的毁灭。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God of hosts: O my people, who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians when they beat you with a rod and lift up their staff against you as the Egyptians did.
text_cn: 因此吾主，万军的上主这样说：我的百姓，熙雍的居民！亚述虽然用木棒痛击你，像埃及一样，举起棍杖敲打你，但你不必害怕，

text_en: For in a very little while my indignation will come to an end, and my anger will be directed to their destruction.
text_cn: 因为瞬息间我的怒气即将终止，我的愤怒将转为他们的毁灭。

text_en: The Lord of hosts will wield a whip against them, as when he struck Midian at the rock of Oreb; his staff will be over the sea, and he will lift it as he did in Egypt.
text_cn: 万军的上主将挥动刑鞭鞭打他们，有如昔日在曷勒布磐石处打击米德杨一样；高举向海上伸出的棍杖，有如在埃及一样。

text_en: On that day his burden will be removed from your shoulder, and his yoke will be destroyed from your neck. He has gone up from Rimmon,
text_cn: 到那日，她的重负将由你肩上卸下，她的重轭（è）将由你颈上解除。

text_en: he has come to Aiath; he has passed through Migron, at Michmash he stores his baggage;
text_cn: 破坏者由黎孟而来，来到阿雅特，经过米革龙，将辎重贮在米革玛斯；

text_en: they have crossed over the pass, at Geba they lodge for the night; Ramah trembles, Gibeah of Saul has fled.
text_cn: 又穿过要隘，夜宿革巴。辣玛惊慌了，撒乌耳的基贝亚逃走了。

text_en: Cry aloud, O daughter Gallim! Listen, O Laishah! Answer her, O Anathoth!
text_cn: 巴特加林！你们应大声疾呼；拉依士！你们应该倾听；阿纳托特！你们应该回答。

text_en: Madmenah is in flight, the inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
text_cn: 玛德默纳走散了，革平的居民逃避了。

text_en: This very day he will halt at Nob, he will shake his fist at the mount of daughter Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 在诺布暂停一天，遂即挥手指向熙雍女儿山，耶路撒冷的山岗。

text_en: Look, the Sovereign, the Lord of hosts, will lop the boughs with terrifying power; the tallest trees will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
text_cn: 看啊！吾主，万军的上主将用斧钺砍伐枝干：高出的要削去，耸出的要砍低。

text_en: He will hack down the thickets of the forest with an ax, and Lebanon with its majestic trees will fall.
text_cn: 他将用铁斧砍伐丛林，黎巴嫩和她的壮丽必被伐倒。
